title: STAMOS BIEN: The 102’ Flybridge Yacht Redefining Interior Connection
description: 102' Maiora STAMOS BIEN — 2001 flybridge yacht with panoramic salon windows and Italian lines; $1.175M, Miami.
html:
102′ Maiora Flybridge Motor Yacht — Elegant STAMOS BIEN

The 102′ Maiora flybridge motor yacht STAMOS BIEN, a 2001 model now offered from Miami for $1,175,000 and with crypto accepted, presents a distinctive profile where architectural intent meets seagoing functionality. Her sculpted exterior lines and oversized, obscured glazing give the salon and bar extraordinary sightlines to the water, creating a continuous visual connection between interior living spaces and the surrounding ocean; the result is a yacht that reads as a cohesive design statement while remaining purpose-built for extended cruising and guest entertainment.

STAMOS BIEN’s exterior is immediately recognizable for its sweeping sheer and integrated windows that run through the main salon, framing panoramic views and admitting abundant natural light without sacrificing privacy. At 102′ (31.09 m) and with a 22’3″ (6.78 m) beam, she balances generous interior volume with clean, modern lines on deck, creating a vessel that appears both substantial and streamlined when underway or at rest.

Spacious Interior Layout and Four-Cabin Accommodations

The interior layout is organized for socializing and comfortable overnighting, with a salon that includes a bar area oriented toward the sea and large glazed panels providing near-unobstructed views; accommodations comprise four cabins served by four heads, offering private staterooms for owners and guests. Generous circulation, thoughtful sightlines and the interplay of interior and exterior spaces make the yacht well suited to extended cruises or hosting family and friends.

Performance, MTU Power and Recent Mechanical Upgrades

STAMOS BIEN is powered by twin MTU 16V2000 diesel inboard engines, each producing approximately 1,800 hp, which deliver a cruising speed around 20 knots and a top speed near 24 knots — a profile that supports efficient passage-making and fast repositioning between islands or marinas. The broker can provide detailed maintenance records and a list of recent mechanical work; prospective buyers are encouraged to review service history and survey findings to confirm current condition and systems timelines.

Exterior Design, Decks, Flybridge and Panoramic Views

Deck configuration emphasizes outdoor living: the main deck aft and flybridge provide multiple entertaining zones, and the elevated helm on the flybridge affords commanding visibility for navigation and docking. Large windows on the main salon extend visual lines to the horizon, while deck spaces are arranged to support alfresco dining, sunning and social gatherings — all designed to make the most of cruising days in south Florida and beyond.

Avionics, Onboard Systems and Entertainment Options

The vessel’s bridge and pilothouse areas are arranged for practical operation and guest interaction, and the salon/bar layout supports onboard entertaining and media setups; a full inventory of navigation electronics, communications gear and entertainment systems is available from the listing broker. Systems servicing (generators, HVAC, plumbing and electrical distribution) and any recent upgrades can be reviewed upon request to verify how the yacht’s equipment matches a buyer’s operational needs.

Key Features Recap and How to Schedule a Viewing

Notable points include the distinctive Maiora exterior styling and expansive glazing, a four-cabin/four-head guest plan, twin MTU 16V2000 diesels (~1,800 hp each) with 20 kt cruising performance, and a flybridge-forward layout that supports both passagemaking and social use; STAMOS BIEN is offered from Miami at $1,175,000 and the listing indicates crypto is accepted. To arrange a showing, request full specifications or obtain additional photographs and maintenance documentation, please contact the listing broker to schedule a time and receive the complete equipment and service history.

For more information on this yacht including additional pictures and brochures, or to schedule a tour, please contact us below. While efforts have been made to ensure accuracy, readers are encouraged to verify details independently.
